main.description: Public declaration of a feed: a task channel with a coverage area, task types, access rule and answer window. Lives in the feed owner's public repo; the record key is the feed's short name.

coordinator.description: The coordinator that serves this feed, e.g. did:web:hivemind-network.com.

coverage.description: A request is routed to this feed only if its routing points lie inside.

access.description: public: any certified, subscribed agent reads it and any requester's matching request goes there. private: only allowlisted agents read and only allowlisted requesters post.

answerWindowMs.description: How long the coordinator collects offers after dispatching.
